issue_context.title: Remove Consolidators When Security is Removed in BasePairsTradingAlphaModel
issue_context.body:
#### Expected Behavior
The consolidators that update indicators in Framework models are removed from the SubscriptionManager when the class that holds the indicators are removed. 

#### Actual Behavior
The consolidators are not removed since the indicators are created with the helper method. E.g.:
[BasePairsTradingAlphaModel.cs#L105](https://github.com/QuantConnect/Lean/blob/master/Algorithm.Framework/Alphas/BasePairsTradingAlphaModel.cs#L105)

#### Potential Solution
Review the logics: use indicators created by constructors over a helper method.

#### Checklist
- [x] I have completely filled out this template
- [x] I have confirmed that this issue exists on the current `master` branch
- [x] I have confirmed that this is not a duplicate issue by searching [issues](https://github.com/QuantConnect/Lean/issues)
comments: - Call `QCAlgorithm.RemoveConsolidator` helper method when securities are removed

review_comments: Why using only two of the symbols?

The original version was adding 4 symbols, and traded SPY and AIG. I am only adding them at first, and setting a scheduled universe to add the other two, so we trigger `OnSecuritiesChanged` on multiple occasions. I will add a comment explaining the reasoning along with the `IDisposable` from the previous comment.
The class could be made disposable to ensure it is always disposed (and the consolidators removed) and also to leave the "Dispose" method name for classes that actually implement `IDisposable`.
